name: Schwimmbad Restaurant Schwaz
kurzbeschreibung:
**Swimming Pool Restaurant Schwaz in Schwaz** – Enjoy a refreshing break after your swim in the **Schwaz** outdoor pool, surrounded by the stunning Alpine scenery of **Tirol**. Indulge in hearty Austrian dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Wiener Schnitzel**, or a cozy bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl**, paired with local craft beers and fine wines. The terrace offers a perfect view of the **Zillertal Alps**, while the rustic interior invites you to relax in true **Tiroler Gemütlichkeit**. Whether you're a family, a group of friends, or traveling solo, this spot is the ideal place to recharge before exploring the historic town of **Schwaz** or the nearby **Achensee**. Don’t miss the homemade desserts—especially the **Apfelstrudel** with vanilla sauce!
